workloads.label: hidden-state-reduce
workloads.reason: manifest hidden-state-reduce bf16, dim=-1; resident path wrapper block_m=4. R9 (2026-10-26): bf16 has NO native min in hivm -- T.reduce_min/T.vmin(bf16) both lower to vcast(bf16->f32)+f32 min+vcast (IR-verified), so the explicit vcast + fp32 work buffer is the minimal form; int16 bits-domain route measured 2.3x slower. Path unchanged.
